## ♿ Accessibility Checklist / অ্যাক্সেসিবিলিটি চেকলিস্ট

- [ ] All icon-only buttons have explicit `aria-label` or accessible names.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Escape) works seamlessly across interactive elements.
- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
- [ ] Live region announcements handle dynamic user updates appropriately.
